still_open: MK-PF-F-006: Accept an explicitly entered zero adjusted basis; with missing holding dates give unknown tax-duration split. Label this as holding-duration information unless wrapper and special option tax rules are accounted for.
MK-PF-F-007: Retain the dollar gain against cost as a separate fact, but compute any return through the common TWR or refuse if it lacks valuations/movement dates.
MK-PF-F-008: Define canonical period keys and an explicit Since start contract; refuse unsupported keys and invalid dates; do not map absent Since history to today as performance.
MK-PF-F-009: Enforce valid finite points at ingestion and specify conflicts; callers measuring to today must cap points to today and expose stale as-of dates.
MK-PF-F-010: Use one parts reader with the decided first-price fallback, valid as-of bound, actual coverage dates and one owner-approved annualization convention.
MK-PF-F-011: Require a valid start not after now, select latest valid price on/before now, return total with coverage metadata and let one presentation rule decide annualization.
MK-PF-F-012: Select genuine positive purchases through today; expose missing purchase-date coverage rather than silently call the earliest known lot the first purchase.
MK-PF-F-013: Keep confirmed class first; refuse unresolved classification; do not use tax wrapper as investment allocation. Specify recognized-kind versus broker-class precedence.

MK-PF-F-014: Use daily movement-neutral links with the DEC-4439 beginning-of-day convention, refuse undated genuine flows, and share all total/coverage/date readers. Keep row dollar facts distinct from TWR.

formula_checks.why: ReturnSincePurchases values old shares at the purchase-day close before adding the morning purchase, contrary to DEC-4439; undated lots are moved to an invented first day. Zero-purchase caps and short-history parts also diverge.
formula_checks.should_be: Use daily movement-neutral links with the DEC-4439 beginning-of-day convention, refuse undated genuine flows, and share all total/coverage/date readers. Keep row dollar facts distinct from TWR.
